caption: The drawing features a wooden figurine of a uniformed man standing on a rectangular base. The figurine is dressed in a dark blue or black military-style outfit with gold-colored buttons arranged in two rows down the front of the jacket, and a strap running diagonally from his right shoulder to his left hip. He wears a matching cap on his head, has a prominent brown beard and mustache, and his facial features are angular, painted in shades of brown and beige. The trousers are dark and tucked into high black boots. A sword hangs from his left side, secured by a belt. The rectangular base on which the figure stands is brown with a marbled pattern. The figure is centered against a plain, light tan background, and is framed by a thin rectangular border.
title: Civil War Soldier
